item.title: Jewish Community in Tanzania Celebrates New Torah
item.description: A moving and uplifting Hachnasas Sefer Torah ceremony was held at Chabad of Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, led by the Rebbe’s shluchim to the city and country, Rabbi Shimi and Chani Aziza. Full Story

item.title: Watch: She Just Wants a Seat at the Table
item.description: “When I told my husband I wanted a divorce, he locked me in my room.” In a devastating video now being shared, divorced and widowed Jewish women tell the stories they once kept secret. She suffered in silence. Don’t turn away now. Watch the video. Full Story

item.title: Kinus Tzeirei Hashluchos Concludes With Finale Event
item.description: Over 2,000 Young Shluchos joining both the in person and virtual track of the Kinus Tzeirei Hashluchos of the Shluchim Office joined together for their Grand finale event, celebrating three amazing days of Chassidishkeit, fun and connection. Full Story, Photos

item.description: Nshei Chabad women and girls gathered for a farbrengen marking the yortzeit hillula of our beloved Rebbetzin at Bais Rivka in Crown Heights. Full Story, Photos

item.title: “I Rediscovered My Hungarian Grandma’s Judaism”
